description.value:
Set 300 metres from Midigama Beach, Lotus Surf House offers 3-star accommodation in Midigama and has a garden, a shared lounge and a terrace. The accommodation offers a shared kitchen, room service and luggage storage for guests.

Featuring a private bathroom with a shower, rooms at the hotel also have free WiFi, while some rooms also offer a balcony.

Guests at Lotus Surf House can enjoy a continental breakfast.

You can play table tennis at the accommodation, and the area is popular for hiking and fishing.

Koggala Airport is 10 km from the property, and the property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

quotes.text:
WOW - the BEST place to stay in Midigama 🫶 

I spent a wonderful three weeks staying at Lotus Surf House. The couple who own and run the place are so so kind, helpful and caring. As a solo female traveller, I felt extremely safe staying there. It was lovely to chat with other guests, friendly vibes!

The guesthouse is only a 2 minute walk to the beach and the nearest restaurants and shops are 1 minute walk. Just off the main road, the area is peaceful. The train passes by a few times a day, however not an issue at all. 

I stayed a few days in the Queen fan room, the room was simple and spacious. For the majority of my stay, I was in the King Room with AC. This room is brand new, big, balcony, AC & fan and has hot water shower. The room is perfect! 

WiFi works well for those who work online. A delicious breakfast is included, just choose that morning out of a few choices. 

When I return to Midigama, I will 100% be staying at Lotus Surf House again. Thank you🧡

Sehr gutes Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis – die Unterkunft war genauso wie auf den Bildern. Großes, sehr helles und lichtdurchflutetes Zimmer mit bequemem Bett, großem Badezimmer, guter Dusche und Balkon. Für den Preis wirklich außergewöhnlich gut.
Das Frühstück war sehr lecker und abwechslungsreich, man konnte täglich aus mehreren Optionen wählen. Der Gastgeber war extrem freundlich, hilfsbereit und jederzeit ansprechbar, z. B. beim Rollerverleih. Man merkt, dass hier an viele Details gedacht wurde: Nachttischlampen, gut platzierte Klimaanlage (nicht direkt aufs Bett), Moskitonetz sowie ausreichend Ablageflächen – was man nicht überall findet.
Die Lage ist ebenfalls top: Nur ein paar hundert Meter bis zum Strand, viele sehr gute Restaurants fußläufig erreichbar und trotzdem nicht direkt an der Hauptstraße gelegen. Züge hört man gelegentlich, was in Sri Lanka jedoch ganz normal ist und uns nicht gestört hat.
Wir hatten gelesen, dass in früheren Bewertungen von Bauarbeiten die Rede war. Während unseres Aufenthalts wurden im Haus noch zwei weitere Zimmer fertiggestellt, die bereits an unserem letzten Reisetag in Betrieb genommen wurden. Der Baulärm war minimal, und wir wurden immer gefragt, ob alles für uns in Ordnung ist – also war kein kein Problem. 
Wir haben uns rundum wohlgefühlt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

Very nice Homestay with various breakfast included. 5 rooms with privat Bath are located into a nice shadowy garden, which makes it a nice familiar athmosphere. The rooms (with fan) are simple and clean and have everything you need. Yelum the SriLankan owner is very nice and helpfull in every situation and speaks very well englisch. He and his family run the location. They also rent Scooter, do laundry, and make nice breakfast. There is a waterstation where you can refill your water (with a box for money when you use it). They are not obtrusive but help when you ask. 
The Location is just a few minutes walk from the nice beaches from Midigama. 
You can surf lazy left and lazy right and rent a surfboard just at the corner of the beach. There are a few nice restaurants with good srilankan food nearby. The railwaytracks are nearby but the trains that comes from time to time did not disturb me. The Spa Station next door is run by the brother of Yelum and I can higly recommend to go there! So the whole setting is really nice for a great stay at Midigama. I will come back.

I strive every day to make my customers' holidays as wonderful as possible. If you give me a second chance in the future, I would be delighted to personally present all the new features to you.

Breakfast is served from 8 a.m. to 10 a.m. It is very painful for me that we were apparently unable to meet your expectations due to a communication problem.
